chapter.title: Running software built for FHS systems
chapter.para: Most software assumes FHS paths: scripts start with #!/usr/bin/env, programs open /etc/passwd or /usr/share/…, and binaries built elsewhere name /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 as their loader. A DHS system runs such software in two ways: packages are adapted when they are installed, and paths that are still FHS-shaped are resolved when they are used.

section.title: Path resolution
section.para: An implementation SHOULD provide a path resolver that takes effect when a program opens, executes or inspects an FHS path that does not exist. The resolver applies only to paths whose first component is one of bin, sbin, lib, usr, opt, var, etc or boot; /home, /tmp and the virtual filesystems are never changed. It rewrites the path as follows and uses the first candidate that exists:

listitem.para: Map lib/modules to drivers/modules, lib/firmware to drivers/hardware/firmwares and boot to kernel.
Try the result under, in order, /overlayer/syshub, the musl directory, /overlayer/zexlib/union and /overlayer/zaisys.

section.para: For example, /usr/bin/env becomes /overlayer/syshub/bin/env, /etc/passwd becomes /overlayer/syshub/etc/passwd and /usr/include/zlib.h becomes /overlayer/syshub/include/zlib.h.
The resolver MUST work in programs of both C libraries and therefore SHOULD NOT depend on either C library itself.

note.title: Implementation note
note.para: Zainium OS implements the resolver as libsys_resolver.so, preloaded into service manager units, login shells and PAM sessions. A preloaded library cannot act in statically linked or setuid programs, because the loader does not preload into those.

section.title: Loader redirection
section.para: When a program is executed whose interpreter path does not exist — for example /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 or /lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 — the implementation SHOULD start it with the installed loader of the same C library, passing the program as an argument and keeping its name as argv[0]. If the matching C library is not installed, the program fails as it would on any system without that library.

section.title: Packages from other distributions
section.para: A package manager that installs packages built for other distributions SHOULD adapt them when installing: set the loader and library path of musl programs to DHS paths, rewrite pkg-config prefixes and script interpreters (#! lines) to DHS paths, and place the files under /overlayer/zexlib/union. Programs linked against glibc are not changed ().
